data.code_commit_message:
fix(cpu): add BZ_N support, MUL HI/LO writeback, and snapshot bz_negate

Add BZ_N (branch when Z=0) instruction support via bz_negate flag in
decode and fetch. Fix MUL to properly write results to HI/LO registers
via fromMultiply enum. Serialize bz_negate in snapshot for state restore.
